item.tib: gsang ba 'dus pa thabs chen yab kyi rgyud
gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs las gsang ba 'dus pa thabs chen yab kyi rgyud
item.coloph: de ltar gsang 'dus zhi khro'i rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa'i thugs kyi bcud bla chen dran pa nam mkhas gdams dran pa'i gsang bcud bI rA+or gnang gnas chen tsha rong gter du sbas gter srung sde lngar gnyer gtad kyis skal med lag tu ma shor la las ldan bu la 'phrod par kyis (gyis ) rgya rgya rgya u la ag tham 8 ces pa'i gsang rgyud 'di ni bstan gnyis gsang sngags gling pas tsha ba rong chen gnas nas spyan drangs shing / phyis su rtog (rtogs) ldan rin po che bkra shis rgyal mtshan dang khro sprul g.yung drung mthong grol dang khro bon sogs skyes bu dam pa du mas bskul ngor dag par phab pa'o//

item.tib: gsang ba 'dus pa thabs chen yab kyi rgyud ces bya ba'i dbu phyogs
